description: [Read · free] Given two companies, return the people who engaged (reacted or commented) with posts published by BOTH companies' own LinkedIn pages, counting only company-page posts and engagers already collected in your library. Use it to find people interested in two target accounts at once. It does NOT compare which employees of each company engage with you (for that, use get_post_engagers_by_company). It needs data collected first: each company's page posts (a company stream, or linkedin_company_posts) and their engagers (get_post_set_engagers on those posts, or linkedin_post_reactions / linkedin_post_comments); when a company has no page posts in your library the response says so. Identify each company by company_x_url, company_x_linkedin_id (LinkedIn's numeric id, as linkedin_company_info returns it), company_x_name (exact, case-insensitive; several matches return candidates instead of a guess) or company_x_id (companies.id UUID). A company not saved in Flux returns `_meta.next_step` naming linkedin_company_info (1 credit). Pure DB read — no LinkedIn pull, no credits charged.

company_a_linkedin_id.description: Company A — LinkedIn's numeric company id (from linkedin_company_info)

company_a_name.description: Company A — exact company name, case-insensitive

company_b_linkedin_id.description: Company B — LinkedIn's numeric company id (from linkedin_company_info)

company_b_name.description: Company B — exact company name, case-insensitive

limit.description: Max overlapping engagers to return (1-100, default 20)

name: get_company_engagement_overlap
title: Company Engagement Overlap
